 Gary Rose and Jess Anderson
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 19:30 GMT 19:30 GMT 
 FT: Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Oliver Glasner looks absolutely elated. He goes round all of his players congratulating them before applaudig the crowd.
 It was fighting talk from him last week and his players have answered the rallying cry.
 32 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'City have been exposed today' published at 19:28 GMT 19:28 GMT 
 FT: Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 Before the game all the talk was about individual errors. This hasn't been about that, apart from the first goal, the line is disjointed. 
 The fullbacks are very wide. If the ball turns over quick and you pass it with your first pass you can be right through them. 
 They've been exposed today, Glasner's team have played through them every time. 
 254 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 FULL-TIME published at 19:25 GMT 19:25 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 That is that.
 What a performance from Nottingham Forest. Out of the relegation zone and Liam Delap firing in two goals.
 For Manchester City and Enzo Maresca, it's more questions after yet more individual errors prove costly.
 2216 114 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 19:24 GMT 19:24 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Time is almost up.
 Phil Foden drives forward and is caught by Luca Netz, who goes into the book.
 195 286 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Forest's defenders have been compact' published at 19:22 GMT 19:22 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 Forest's three central defenders have been really good this afternoon. 
 Jair Cunha just before that was really strong, we've seen Erling Haaland out muscle people so many times and the defenders have done well today.
 They've been compact and have worked well together. 
 885 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:22 GMT 19:22 GMT 
 Use 'Get involved' to have your say 
 No heart, no fight, no clue, no fresh ideas from City. In saying that, well played Forest. Good old fashioned centre forward play from Delap.
 Ged, Swindon 
 1424 97 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:22 GMT 19:22 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 City have been getting the ball in some decent areas but it does not feel like anything is going to come for them at this point.
 A goal might make the scoreline a bit nicer for them but a comeback is unlikely.
 328 68 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Man City have run out of ideas' published at 19:17 GMT 19:17 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 It's one where City just look dejected, they've run out of ideas. The third goal has absolutely deflated the whole team. 
 They've brought on Phil Foden to try and get a bit going but it hasn't really worked. 
 It's been positive for Forest tonight and the manager will be delighted. 
 Image source, PA Media 
 1384 102 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 19:17 GMT 19:17 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Liam Delap makes way for Igor Jesus.
 Finally he has showed why Forest spent the big bucks on him this summer.
 912 60 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:15 GMT 19:15 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 This is the first time Man City have conceded three goals against a team starting the day in the Premier League relegation zone since September 2019 (2-3 v Norwich) and first time after at least 10 games since December 2009 (3-3 v Bolton).
 788 97 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:15 GMT 19:15 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Manchester City have been on top for large periods of this game but that second Liam Delap goal has knocked them for six.
 901 93 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:11 GMT 19:11 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Just how big of a turning point could this be for Nottingham Forest? Oliver Glasner asked for patience, is his vision finally coming to fruition?
 This result will see them clear of the Premier League relegation zone by two points.
 1137 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 19:09 GMT 19:09 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Enzo Maresca turns to his bench.
 Phil Foden is on for Enzo Fernandez.
 For the hosts, Ryan Yates makes way for Ibrahim Sangare.
 359 158 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:08 GMT 19:08 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 A tough old season for Liam Delap but two goals tonight against second-in-the-league Manchester City.
 A change in fortune, perhaps?
 1251 126 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:07 GMT 19:07 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 GOAL OF THE SEASON!
 Nick, Cornwall 
 Liam Delap is the next £100 million player.
 Bill, London 
 BOOOOOOM BOOOOM BABY
 Will, Manchester 
 1441 371 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:07 GMT 19:07 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Around 14 minutes on the clock.
 Is there another twist in this? Manchester City win a corner but it comes to nothing.
 422 116 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The whole place erupts' published at 19:06 GMT 19:06 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 I haven't seen anything like this in a long time. Liam Delap takes one touch, hasn't thought about it and it curls away from the goalkeeper. 
 He hits it so clean, the whole place just erupts and the pressure is taken off them. 
 The club has been through a tough period, they've scored three against a really good Man City team. That's emotion. 
 1484 121 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:06 GMT 19:06 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City 
 Oliver Glasner ran the length of the pitch from his technical area to go and celebrate with Liam Delap, Mourinho-esque.
 Brilliant celebrations.
 1392 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Nottm Forest 3-1 Man City published at 19:03 GMT 19:03 GMT 
 Liam Delap (73 mins) 
 Manchester City have been on top this half but surely Nottingham Forest have just sealed a huge victory!
 Forest win the ball back deep in their own half and Morgan Gibbs-White turns defence into attack with a lightning quick counter.
 He finds Liam Delap and the striker shoots towards the far top corner and it pings off the woodwork and in at the other side.
 What a finish, Delap at the double!
 Image source, PA Media 
 6246 578 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Yates couldn't shoot quick enough' published at 18:59 GMT 18:59 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 Ryan Yates just couldn't get his shot off quick enough and Elliott Anderson managed to get it over the bar. I still think City are on top.
 Image source, Reuters
